Marissa / Ben — thanks for routing. Internal checklist and next steps below: 

1) Bank verification: we require EITHER a bank letter on official letterhead OR a voided check plus a completed bank change form (their form is attached). BlueStone already provided a signed bank_change_form; ask them to attach the bank letter or a PDF of a voided check.

2) Vendor master update: Procurement will log the request and place a temporary HOLD on ACH disbursements to the old account until verification completes. This prevents duplicate payments.

3) Open POs: if invoices for existing POs are already in the AP queue, Finance (Ben) will decide if reissue is needed. In most cases we do not reissue POs — we update vendor payment info and annotate the PO. We need Ben to confirm tolerance.

4) Ship-to change: Ops (Grace) — please confirm whether the new warehouse address is on our approved carrier list and whether any additional site access docs are needed.

5) Document retention: store the bank letter / voided check in vendor secure storage and link to HubSpot / vendor record (we will use the DocuSign link if they send it).

Action items: 
- Lena: please upload bank_letter_bluestone.pdf or voided check to the DocuSign link and confirm effective date.
- Ben: confirm tolerance on PO reissue by EOD Monday (25 May).
- Grace: confirm logistics compliance for the new ship-to by EOD Monday.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
